limits: Native renderer coordinates and screenshots are bounded observations. Target index maps through native host first index only because raw SOURCE_INDEX_SCALED certifies the matching host origin. Cross-screenshot live extent is not assumed identical. Dynamic main-bar color has no pane-view item in this extraction and remains available in PNG/source data; no invented barcolor result. Original grouped panes include arrow/candle price extents, so y-lane scale can be compressed. V3 refusals are undeclared bar_index, not an offset-overload ruling.
